steps.title: HTTPS and WSS enter through the same secure boundary
steps.question: Where is encryption checked, and where does the request go next?
explanation: The browser connects to the trusted HTTPS/WSS entry. The proxy presents the certificate, then forwards a matching API or socket path to an internal service. The internal hop may use a different protocol, but the browser must not silently disable certificate checks.
Development certificates are for local use and their secret keys must stay out of Git. Production certificate ownership belongs to the team’s deployment process.
